audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly

progression.localImplementation: Native prose and public intermediate/final CLI checks; remote delivery and enforced instructor policies remain pending

title: Build a ChaCha20 stream cipher
prerequisites: Counted byte arrays, word arithmetic and full-width pointers
Preserved registers, nested calls and stack frames
MSA word lanes and destination-lane shuffle selectors
learningObjectives: Trace quarter-round dependencies and word rotations
Select columns and diagonals of a raw sixteen-word state
Preserve original words for final feed-forward
Use row vectors and inverse shuffles for four quarter-rounds
Transform exact byte intervals, including an in-place tail
Reject counter exhaustion before output writes
Distinguish instruction work, host time and authentication
